subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should an authorized `sessions.abort` request for a non-global channel session permanently cancel that session’s queued successor turns, rather than only aborting the active run?
rationale: The branch intentionally suppresses queued work and outbound messages for the selected session; that is a user-visible delivery and session-lifecycle contract that tests can demonstrate but cannot choose on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Approve scoped queue cancellation
options.body: Confirm that selected non-global session stops are defined to cancel queued successors, then rebase and retain the queue/embedded-run ordering tests.

options.title: Preserve queued successors
options.body: Limit the new fallback to aborting the active run and leave queued selected-session work to drain if the existing RPC contract should not suppress it.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped queue cancellation
recommendation.body: Confirm that selected non-global session stops are defined to cancel queued successors, then rebase and retain the queue/embedded-run ordering tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the narrowed design rationale and the direct QA evidence for the proposed session-stop semantics.
